instruction: You're looking outside at a patio, you can see some couches and an ottoman in front of you. If you turn around behind you you'll see a living room with a fireplace to the right and in front of you a white couch. Take a step into this room. If you turn to the left you should see a hallway. Walk towards this hallway. And then to the left you should see a glass table and to the right a white cabinet. Continue walking past these down the hallway. And you'll walk past a brown door you should see a kitchen in front of you. Continue walking forward in the kitchen. You'll see an island to the left and some stools. And on the right you should see some brown cabinets. Walk past these brown cabinets and you'll see some stairs to your right. And then slightly to the left you'll see an outdoor patio area, walk towards this outdoor patio area. And take a step outside. And walk to the right of this white couch. And then to your right you'll see a blue couch on the inside and in front of it a white table. Walk to the corner of this white table and once you're standing in front of the white table at the corner you've reached the end.
